milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate toward the white concrete powder structure (centered at spawn-relative ~8, ~1, ~8) and face it, confirming visual observation. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable range, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the structure.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The oak trapdoor is at spawn-relative (8, 0, 8) on the floor inside the white concrete powder structure. The player must get close (max_distance=5) and look toward it (facing_tolerance=60), confirming they've entered the structure and found the trapdoor. Tighter distance than the first task since the trapdoor is small and inside the structure.

Uses inventory_has because mining a hay_block drops the hay_block item (or wheat if broken without proper tool — but hay blocks always drop themselves regardless of tool). The mined hay_block ends up in the player's inventory, confirming successful mining. This is preferred over mine_block event tracking because inventory_has directly verifies the outcome.
